part.text:
Implemented the ACL rule compaction fix in `src/server.c:3194`.

The retained ACL rules are now rebuilt correctly, removing subcommand rules when a parent command is re-added or removed. This fixes cases like `+config|get -config|set +config`, which now reports `+config` as expected.

Validated with:
- `unit/acl` — all tests passed
- `unit/acl-v2` — all tests passed
